fields.statement: Rhiza runs unattended overnight: the daemon builds, reviews, lands and merges accepted change sets, and plans its own PRs, without the orchestrator committing, rebasing, fixing ship records or closing windows by hand

Milestone 6 is the run-machinery fixes that needed the orchestrator's hand in milestones 4 and 5: tiled agent, arbiter and advisor sessions; link kinds checked at write; plan runs shipping their plan; runs following a moved PR head; plan runs stopping on open findings; leaf fixers retried within their cycle; and housekeeping
fields.wording: Tiled agent sessions, Link kinds checked at write, Plan run ships its plan, Runs follow a moved PR head (all recommended), plus Plan run open findings, Failed fixer retried in cycle and Housekeeping, the agent's options, picked by the owner

fields.statement: An arbiter session's pane closes once its verdict is journalled, and an advisor's once its recommendation is, so one run window does not fill with ever smaller panes
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A link write whose type does not go between its ends' kinds is refused as a usage error, with no way past it, using the same endpoint table rhiza check uses; the kind check comes after the note and decision checks, so their messages keep precedence
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A plan run ships its plan as ship-change ships code, minus landing: it renders and commits, opens the PR, waits for green CI, merges it and closes out the branch and worktree; it never lands the change set, whose acceptance stays the owner's gate
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A plan run whose gate finds unanswered questions stops for the owner before any PR step, listing them in run status and the inbox; once they are answered, resuming goes on to ship the plan
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A run follows a PR head it did not push only when that head contains the head the run pushed; a head that drops the run's commits stops with a question; ship check only adopts the head, and the write steps fast-forward a clean worktree to it, refusing one with uncommitted changes or local commits the head lacks; a branch that holds a merge of main is merged with main again rather than rebased
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: A failed review leaf fixer or verifier is retried within its cycle as a fresh fixer and verifier attempt, with the change-set fixer's budget (MaxFixCycles more attempts), each attempt keyed apart from the others
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: Housekeeping is one change set, 01M6489HCR: the picker is already gone (PR #77), so it adds a regression test for rhiza tui launch and drops the quick-launch wording, and it rewrites the stale statements of read-apps-match-cli (ready, show, why and slice only), tui-read-apps and tui-install-script; the duplicate picker draft 01M6489G9T and draft 01M676WQ33 are withdrawn into it
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
